messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — tenant acme-corp triggered quota alerts. Console shows a routing-policy change around 2025-11-03T14:23Z. Who rolled this out?
Priya Kapoor: I saw it, looks like the canary for routing-policy-service (v2) started at ~14:20 UTC. :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: that was me — I patched fallback weights for competitor-model. I didn’t touch tenant-scoped quotas. @Priya could the template have been applied wrongly?
Priya Kapoor: console shows target selector = tenant_id:acme-corp. your change was supposed to be region-only. hmm.
Jules: can we pull the audit trail — need actor, precise diff, and any justification text. export with PII redaction. @export-bot queue an ndjson export for acme-corp?
export-bot: export job queued. url: s3://redwood-exports/audit/1764509876-acme.ndjson.gz (pii_redaction=partial). ETA: ~2m. job_id=job-88f2
Neha R: what exact fields are in ndjson? we need the original fallback_weight value to reproduce the behavior.
Alex Chen: sample line from export (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2025-11-03T14:23:12Z","actor":"Samir Patel","action":"update","resource":"routing_policy:acme-corp","diff":{"fallback_weight":{"from":0.15,"to":0.05}},"justification":"reduce cost for acme internal routing"}
```
Samir Patel: justification was to test a quick rollback path for cost, I added it in the change form. I didn’t intend to target tenant policy; my selector should have been region:us-east only.
Priya Kapoor: ok — ops question: can console rollout UX do a better job surfacing whether a change is tenant-scoped vs region-scoped? I missed that the resolved target was a single tenant.
Jules: yes. proposal: pre-flight modal that shows resolved target scope + count (e.g., "applies to 1 tenant" vs "applies to 50 hosts"). require explicit confirmation if target resolves to tenants. Also include the rollout-id in the audit events so we can map policy changes to a rollout.
Neha R: +1. Also add the rollout-id to the export payload so downstream incident tooling can correlate.
Alex Chen: I’ll file a short RFC with mockups for the modal + rollout-id in the audit schema and assign actions.
Priya Kapoor: filing RFC now, will include mockups and suggested wording for the modal.
Samir Patel: I’ll update the policy change API to emit rollout_id next week and add a validation to warn when a tenant selector is used with a global template. :thumbsup:
export-bot: export ready: s3://redwood-exports/audit/1764509876-acme.ndjson.gz (filesize: 47KB, lines: 128)
Priya Kapoor: grabbing the file and attaching to the RFC. thanks everyone.
